title: GitHubIdentity
subtitle: Sign in with GitHub — OAuth device flow → OS keychain · IdentityBar (signed-out / connected / sign-out) · plain words, no token paste
brief: Phase 28 (native collab app, epic E3). The IdentityBar lives in the sidebar header: 'Sign in with GitHub' when signed out, avatar + name when signed in. Sign-in is GitHub's OAuth device flow — Maude shows a short code, you enter it on github.com/login/device, the token lands in the OS keychain (never on disk). Vocabulary stays plain: 'Sign in', 'Connected', 'Sign out' — never 'OAuth', 'token', 'PAT'. Lifts the Studio Hub artboard-G returning-operator sign-in card anatomy + the GitPanel shell/menubar docking; swaps the HUB_SECRET paste for the device-flow code.

sections.subtitle: MAUDE/GH · 5 artboards · OAuth device flow → OS keychain · plain words, no token paste

artboards.label: A · Not signed in — Sign in with GitHub
artboards.note: IdentityBar docked in the sidebar header: GitHub sign-in button + one-line why. Menubar still carries the repo/branch context.

artboards.label: B · Device code — enter this code on github.com
artboards.note: Device-flow modal over a dimmed shell: GitHub mark, two steps (open github.com/login/device → enter code), the big mono code WDJB-MJHT with Copy, a pulse 'waiting to authorize' status, Cancel + expiry note.

artboards.label: C · Connected — account menu open
artboards.note: IdentityBar signed-in (avatar + name + @login) with the account dropdown open: View profile on GitHub · Sign out.

artboards.label: D · Sign out confirmation
artboards.note: Small confirm modal: 'Sign out of GitHub?' — projects stay local; you'll need to sign in to publish/create. Stay signed in / Sign out (danger).

artboards.label: E · Edge states — expired · cancelled · connected · browser-only
artboards.note: Callout column: code expired (warn + start again) · sign-in cancelled (error + try again) · connected/token-in-keychain (success) · browser-not-app degradation (info).
